BEYOND THE PIXELS

A little armor. A lot worth protecting.

Meet the real animals behind your rolling companion.

01 / MEET THE PANGOLIN

Scales, not spikes.

Pangolins have overlapping keratin scales, made of the same material as our nails. They eat ants and termites and curl up for protection. Rolling to travel and blocking spears are game fantasy.

Pangolin facts · ZSL ↗
02 / WHY THEY NEED HELP

Threatened in the wild.

All eight recognised species face a high risk of extinction. Overexploitation and habitat loss are major threats; population data remain incomplete. Conservation needs research, habitat protection and work with local communities.

Conservation report · IUCN ↗
03 / HELP THEM THRIVE

Learn. Share. Protect.

Support conservation through the organisations linked here, and never buy pangolin products. Pangolins are in CITES Appendix I: international trade in wild specimens for commercial purposes is prohibited.

Trade protections · IUCN / CITES report ↗
